Method of Attack: Exploitation of zero-day vulnerabilities in Accellion File Transfer Appliance (FTA) software
SQL injection via a crafted Host header (CVE-2021-27101)
OS command execution via a local web service call (CVE-2021-27102)
SSRF via a crafted POST request (CVE-2021-27103)
OS command execution via a crafted POST request (CVE-2021-27104)
Deployment of malicious PHP webshell on compromised Accellion FTA servers to exfiltrate documents
Impacted Systems: Organizations using Accellion FTA including federal, state, local, tribal, and territorial government organizations
Private industry organizations in medical, legal, telecommunications, finance, and energy sectors

Specific impacted organizations: Kroger, Singtel, QIMR Berghofer Medical Research Institute, Reserve Bank of New Zealand, Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC), Office of the Washington State Auditor (SAO)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in Accellion FTA software
Use of crafted HTTP headers and POST requests
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious PHP webshell deployed on compromised Accellion FTA servers
Indicators of compromise (IOCs) provided by Five Eyes alliance
Evidence of data exfiltration and extortion attempts
